title: Anya Taylor-Joy’s 2-Hour Thriller Is Still Her Greatest Movie 10 Years Later
summary: Anya Taylor-Joy is haunting in Split, a crime thriller about a trio of girls who get abducted by an impossible foe.
content: Anya Taylor-Joy ’s film debut in Robert Eggers ’ The Witch may have given the actor a cult following, but it was her role in M. Night Shyamalan ’s Split in 2016 that made her a household name. A year after she shocked horror fans as Thomasin, she took on an incredibly different role in the thriller. A return to form for Shyamalan , Split takes on the complex issue of DID . Dissociative Identity Disorder is at the crux of the movie as James McAvoy takes on 24 separate identities in his role of Kevin.

title: Anya Taylor-Joy’s 93-Minute Crime Thriller 'Thoroughbreds' Is the Perfect Watch Before It’s Cut From Streaming
summary: Anya Taylor-Joy and Olivia Cooke teamed up early in their careers for the crime thriller Thoroughbreds, which leaves Starz on December 1.
content: One of the most unsung releases of the last decade was 2017’s Thoroughbreds , a thriller deep in the film noir mode with three great actors going toe to toe. With Anya Taylor-Joy , Olivia Cooke , and Anton Yelchin as the architects and participants of a murder plot, it’s less a crime movie and more of a character study, with director Cory Finley mining both pathos and extremely dark comedy from the premise. In an era where minimal-location movies about the sociopathy of the rich were frequently successful discourse machines (including Taylor-Joy’s 2022 vehicle The Menu ), Thoroughbreds was a classically amoral story of kids whose wealth insulates them from consequences, yet you still root for them. The movie was unfortunately ahead of the curve with its note-perfect plotting and criminal ideation, as well as its cast.

title: Apple TV’s 2-Part Detective Series Officially Returns in 2026
summary: Vince Vaughn is back in Season 2 of Bad Monkey, and it's coming soon. Read on for more.
content: Andrew Yancy is many things: a disgraced cop, a dedicated restaurant inspector, an animal lover, and a wiseass. Now, he's back for another season of action and misadventure in Bad Monkey . The dark crime comedy series is returning to Apple TV next week.

title: Robert Downey Jr.’s Doctor Doom Officially Returns for New Marvel Release
summary: Marvel and Citizen have unveiled a limited-edition Avengers: Doomsday watch featuring exclusive Doctor Doom artwork ahead of December 18.
content: Given that we spent more than a decade watching Robert Downey Jr. as Tony Stark in the Marvel Cinematic Universe, there's understandably been a great deal of interest in how Marvel Studios will differentiate Downey's Doctor Doom from the man who gave his life to defeat Thanos in Avengers: Endgame . Of course, one of the advantages Marvel has with Doom is that the character has traditionally spent much of his time behind a mask, and while we've seen various interpretations of that mask in the Fantastic Four movies over the years, Marvel has largely stuck with the character's traditional green and gray color scheme in the promotional material for Avengers: Doomsday . That's also the case with Marvel's latest collaboration, although fans hoping to get their hands on this particular piece of merchandise might need to be quick.

title: The 10 Best Christmas War Films, Ranked
summary: War and Christmas go hand in hand in these 10 films.
content: ‘Tis the season to be jolly! But while we all celebrate the holidays with our loved ones, we often forget that the world revolves around them. So, at certain moments in world history, wars broke out during Christmas . What did it mean for the men and women on the battlefield? Well, these ten Christmas war movies may offer some insight!

title: The Best Miniseries of the 2010s, Ranked Year by Year
summary: Every year of the 2010s offered a standout miniseries that wowed critics and audiences, from Olive Kitteridge in 2014 to Sharp Objects in 2018.
content: Serving as both the definitive peak of television’s golden era and the decade that saw the rampant rise in popularity of streaming services producing new shows, it should come as no surprise that the 2010s have an abundance of excellent miniseries. In fact, such is the quality of the miniseries of the decade; each year from 2010 to 2019 has an array of enthralling and memorable titles, with masterpieces like When They See Us , The Haunting of Hill House , and Unbelievable missing out on selection.

title: 3 Best Movies on Netflix This Weekend (Nov 28-29)
summary: Wake Up Dead Man: A Knives Out Mystery, The Mosquito Bowl, and The Best Christmas Pageant Ever make our list of Netflix movies to watch this weekend.
content: Just one more weekend remains this November, and it's worth reflecting on the brilliant month of movies that streaming has had to offer. From unmissable true-crime documentaries to the arrival of the year's biggest horror movie, Netflix has had something for everyone this month. Jared Padalecki and Leighton Meester 's Guarding Stars , based on Katherine Center 's 2022 novel The Bodyguard , is guiding us into the last weekend as the streamer's most-watched movie of the moment. But what else should you be watching? Here's a look at three movies you should watch this weekend on Netflix .

title: The 10 Greatest Sci-Fi TV Antiheroes of All Time, Ranked
summary: Meet the greatest antiheroes in sci-fi TV history, including iconic characters from Rick and Morty, Andor, and Battlestar Galactica.
content: The concept of an antihero is a relatively vague one, but in broad terms, it describes a notable figure in a story who lacks traditional heroic qualities (like selflessness or a strict sense of justice) while still being meant to be rooted for and standing as one of the story's focal points. And if there is any one genre of television that tends to have some fascinating antiheroic characters, it's science fiction.

title: 7 Masterpiece Christmas Books Better Than ‘A Christmas Carol’
summary: As legendary as Charles Dickens’ A Christmas Carol is, books like Little Women and The Nutcracker and the Mouse King are arguably much better.
content: Every Christmas, we turn to the same stories. The same movies the grandparents like , and the song that plays every single Christmas Eve so that everyone in the family can sing along. It is comforting to have stories to return to. Many of the traditions we return to were actually cemented by none other than Charles Dickens . A Christmas Carol is the most popular , having been adapted hundreds of times. Dickens cemented Christmas as we know it today, but that doesn't mean there aren't other Christmas stories worth knowing .

title: New ‘Dungeon Crawler Carl’ Release Officially Set for 2027
summary: Matt Dinniman’s Dungeon Crawler Carl returns in January 2027 with an ongoing comic series from Vault Comics.
content: Between an upcoming television adaptation, collectible editions, and a tremendously successful audiobook series, Matt Dinniman’s Dungeon Crawler Carl has become something of a multimedia phenomenon. The LitRPG sensation has introduced millions of readers to Carl, a Coast Guard veteran who survives the apocalypse alongside his ex-girlfriend’s prize-winning Persian cat, Princess Donut . Unfortunately for Carl, the destruction of civilization also means becoming a contestant on an intergalactic reality show where staying alive is only half the job. Somehow, Donut takes to the celebrity lifestyle remarkably well.

title: 8 Elite HBO Miniseries to Binge Right Now
summary: Sharp Objects, The Undoing, Band of Brothers, The Night Of, Chernobyl, and more make up our list of elite miniseries to binge on HBO.
content: HBO has long had a reputation for prestige, cinematic shows and miniseries. But the network has come a long way since The Far Pavilions and has become synonymous with top-tier, critically acclaimed miniseries. Several of the miniseries that HBO has produced over the last couple of decades are not just another feather in their hat but icons of their genre, TV classics of their time, and standouts among their contemporaries.

title: ‘Fallout’ Officially Returns With Massive New Release Ahead of Season 3
summary: GUNNAR has unveiled a 50% holiday discount on its Fallout eyewear collection, featuring designs inspired by three iconic features.
content: One of the things Prime Video got spot on with its adaptation of Fallout was finding a way to tell an entirely new story within a world that some of us had already spent hundreds (maybe thousands) of hours exploring. While the introduction of Vault 33 gave longtime fans of the games something new to discover alongside Ella Purnell 's Lucy MacLean, seeing the Brotherhood of Steel brought to life was oh so sweet for those of us who'd spent much of Fallout 4 in a suit of power armor. Of course, there's also a particular fondness among fans of the franchise for New Vegas, and all three of those elements have inspired a collection that Fallout fans might want to add to their Christmas lists this year.

title: The Perfect ‘Hunger Games’ Cast if the Movie Were Made in 2026
summary: With the highly anticipated Hunger Games prequel arriving, we dream up a cast that would take on the original had it been made in 2026.
content: Pop culture found its favorite love triangle when The Hunger Games was transformed into a blockbuster movie franchise. Based on the young adult novels by Suzanne Collins , the film is set in a dystopian future in the nation of Panem and follows a teenage girl named Katniss Everdeen ( Jennifer Lawrence ), who volunteers to take her younger sister's place in a televised, annual fight to the death . Alongside her fellow district tribute Peeta Mellark ( Josh Hutcherson ), she must survive the brutal arena while unintentionally sparking a rebellion against the oppressive Capitol.

title: 36 Years Later, Kevin Costner’s Western Masterpiece 'Dances With Wolves' Is Still Better Than ‘Yellowstone’
summary: Yellowstone star Kevin Costner won seven Oscars for Dances with Wolves, the 1990 Western classic that made him a major Hollywood player.
content: Taylor Sheridan’s Yellowstone reinvented the Western for 21st century audiences, but in the last decade of the 20th century, its star Kevin Costner perfected the genre. Now charting on Tubi, 1990's Dances With Wolves remains not only one of Costner’s greatest achievements, but arguably a stronger Western than the hit TV series that later helped revive his cowboy image. The multiple Oscar winner became the high point of the star’s career, cementing him as America’s favorite hero and creating a blueprint for revisionist, thoughtful Westerns that were about more than just shootouts or cavalries.

title: Milla Jovovich’s Sci-Fi Cult Classic Officially Leaves Netflix in 4 Days
summary: Milla Jovovich's Resident Evil: Retribution is officially leaving Netflix in just a few days. Read on for more.
content: After a stellar year for the horror genre , with the likes of Backrooms and Obsession breaking box office records, Halloween also didn't disappoint for fans of the devil's favorite genre. The highlight for many was Resident Evil , as theatergoers returned to the video game-based franchise, this time helmed by horror's best rising star, Zach Cregger . After impressing with both Barbarian and Weapons , and the latter even scoring an unlikely win at the Academy Awards , he delivered three hits out of three with Resident Evil .

title: HBO Max Officially Removes ‘My Big Fat Greek Wedding’ in 4 Days
summary: My Big Fat Greek Wedding is officially saying goodbye to HBO Max in just a few days. Read on for more.
content: There aren't many better sleeper hit comedies from this century than My Big Fat Greek Wedding . Penned by its star, Nia Vardalos , and inspired by her own Greek-Canadian upbringing and her real-life marriage to a non-Greek man, this indie flick gained such positive word of mouth that it became the must-see movie of 2002. Originally, the film opened in just 108 locations and proved quietly popular in a limited capacity for four months.

title: Netflix’s New Jane Austen Adaptation Officially Debuts in 1 Week
summary: Netflix's six-episode Pride and Prejudice series, an adaptation of Jane Austen's iconic novel, premieres in only one week.
content: Bringing one of literature's greatest works to life is no easy task, but Netflix is rising to the challenge with Pride and Prejudice . Written by Jane Austen, Pride and Prejudice was her third novel and the second to be published, released in 1813. At the center is the dynamic between Elizabeth Bennet (whose personal growth drives the story) and the proud, wealthy Mr. Darcy . Through their time together, Elizabeth recognizes the mistakes of judging people too quickly and learns how to distinguish fake charm from true kindness.

title: 'Outlander's 2-Part Spin-Off Officially Returns for Season Finale in 1 Day
summary: Outlander: Blood of My Blood Season 2 ends with an intense tenth episode tomorrow on Starz, wrapping up on a major cliffhanger.
content: After two months of expecting the worst and hoping for the best, Outlander: Blood of My Blood Season 2 ends in less than 24 hours. A prequel to the hit series Outlander , the historical fantasy drama explores the love stories of two couples who lived long before Jamie and Claire Fraser's romance began. Rather than adapting Diana Gabaldon's novels directly, the series expands the Outlander universe by focusing on the parents of its central characters: Jamie's parents, Brian Fraser ( Jamie Roy ) and Ellen MacKenzie ( Harriet Slater ), and Claire's parents, Henry Beauchamp ( Jeremy Irvine ) and Julia Moriston ( Hermione Corfield ).

title: Ridley Scott’s 116-Minute Sci-Fi Masterpiece 'Alien' Is the Perfect Watch Before It’s Cut From Netflix
summary: Ridley Scott's 1979 masterpiece Alien, leaving Netflix on Dec 1, changed the game for sci-fi and female action heroes on the big screen.
content: If you need any convincing as to why Ridley Scott is held in such high regard by movie fans, you only need to fire up Netflix before November 30 and catch his classic Alien . The pioneering sci-fi horror movie led to a franchise consisting of seven films, two spin-offs, and the TV hit Alien: Earth . However, back in 1979, it was just Scott’s vision that terrified audiences and changed the genre as we know it, with star Sigourney Weaver becoming an icon for the ages. If you’ve never experienced the nail-biting first chapter of the space saga, now is the time.

title: 7 Sci-Fi Books That Are Better Than 'Neuromancer'
summary: As good as William Gibson's Neuromancer is, we'd argue that sci-fi books like Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep? and Snow Crash are better.
content: Cyberpunk wouldn't be what it is today without Neuromancer . Long before computers and the Internet became part of everyday life, sci-fi writers were already imagining what the world might look like with such technology, but more importantly, how it would affect humanity. Neuromancer is one of those books, imagining a dystopian society controlled by global computer networks and introducing hackers like Case, who push the boundaries of artificial intelligence.

title: 'The Last of Us' Meets 'Silo' in Hulu’s 4-Part Sci-Fi Thriller
summary: Snowpiercer is a captivating sci-fi series exploring survival and society aboard a luxury train in a frozen world.
content: Post-apocalyptic sci-fi thrillers have become some of TV's best shows. With examples like The Last of Us or Silo , these stories have grown incredibly popular for their spectacle and epic tales. The genre is more than gruesome stories about the world ending, as it offers a deep exploration of universal human struggles. While these recent examples have earned considerable attention, and rightfully so, they are not the first. In fact, Snowpiercer took a similar approach in 2020. The series creates an immersive world full of danger and division that all fans of the genre should watch.

title: 'Star Trek: Deep Space Nine’s Greatest Quote Still Hasn't Been Beaten
summary: Odo's iconic quote from Star Trek: Deep Space Nine leaves its impact across the series with all of its moral complexities.
content: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine is the black sheep of the Star Trek franchise, a truth that has divided opinions ever since its debut in 1993. It eschews the utopian future that was Gene Roddenberry 's vision, with its enlightenment, moral fortitude, and the wonder of exploration, summed up in the "to boldly go where no man has gone before" phrase from its iconic opening narration. In its place is a gritty, darker series that takes place on a stationary outpost, where the ideal is constantly tested by moral ambiguity, subterfuge, and conflict. Nowhere is that challenge more evident than in Star Trek: Deep Space Nine 's greatest quote, one made 33 years ago that began as a statement of belief in moral righteousness, only to become one of dark irony as the series progresses .

title: New ‘Star Trek: Voyager’ Release Will Officially Bring Back a Notorious Storyline
summary: One of Star Trek: Voyager's best episodes is now a DLC pack for the Across the Unknown video game. Read on for more.
content: The new video game Star Trek: Voyager – Across the Unknown has let gamers and Star Trek fans explore the dangerous Delta Quadrant, and make life-or-death choices that would make Kathryn Janeway blanch. Now, a new expansion pack is taking the USS Voyager and her crew into the territory of one of the most dangerous alien races in the quadrant, one whose threat is more terrifying than even the Borg: those who run afoul of them need not worry about assimilation, but complete erasure from existence.

title: Taylor Sheridan’s ‘Tulsa King’ Officially Returns With Major Season 4 Episode
summary: Sylvester Stallone returns as Dwight Manfredi tomorrow when the seventh episode of Tulsa King Season 4 premieres on Paramount+.
content: Considering the entire premise of Tulsa King was that Sylvester Stallone 's Dwight Manfredi was being sent somewhere that his New York associates considered to be of little importance, things have worked out rather well for the General in Oklahoma. Having spent 25 years in prison, Dwight emerged to find that even buying a cup of coffee was a rather different experience from the one he remembered, yet he's managed to put together a fairly lucrative business with a bunch of guys who probably wouldn't have given each other the time of day had they met under different circumstances. His attempts to become a slightly more legitimate businessman have been complicated by the fact that some of Tulsa's supposedly legitimate businessmen aren't much better than him, and we've still got another four episodes to see how that all plays out this year.

title: The 10 Greatest Rock Christmas Songs, Ranked
summary: From Queen’s soaring vocals to the Kinks’ rebellious spirit, these Christmas classics bring rock and roll energy to the holiday season.
content: Christmas and rock and roll have a long history. From Elvis Presley 's 1957 song "Blue Christmas" and Chuck Berry 's speedy classic "Run Rudolph Run" to Paul McCartney 's "Wonderful Christmastime" and Billy Squier 's anthem "Christmas is the Time to Say 'I Love You," holiday rock classics come in a variety of musical packages. These rock songs tap into the excitement, nostalgia and loneliness that tend to accompany the holidays.

title: Netflix's Near-Perfect 8-Episode Sci-Fi Series Is a Weekend Binge Worth Revisiting
summary: Netflix's The Boroughs is a unique sci-fi mystery series — and it's a weekend binge that's still worth revisiting.
content: Perhaps one of streaming's greatest tragedies was the shocking cancellation of the pitch-perfect sci-fi dark comedy The Boroughs . While the logistical reasons are certainly understandable, the series' brilliance may have thrown some viewers for a loop . The eight-episode Netflix series, created by Jeffrey Addiss and Will Matthews and executive produced by the Duffer Brothers , follows a grieving widower who relocates to a seemingly picturesque retirement community, only to discover something sinister lurking underneath. With a dynamic mix of cozy mystery elements and daring sci-fi tropes, The Boroughs moves across genre lines to deliver an emotional, character-driven story.

title: 33 Years Later, the Coldest Quote in Action Thriller History Still Hits Hard
summary: 1993's The Fugitive, streaming free on Pluto, is one of the greatest action thrillers ever, and this famous quote sums up its power.
content: The Fugitive took the world by storm when it was released in 1993. Not only was this action-thriller film, based on the television series from the 1960s, a massive box-office success, but it was also a critical darling and, miraculously, a major Oscar contender, receiving nominations for Best Picture and a win for Tommy Lee Jones for Best Supporting Actor. Starring Harrison Ford as Dr. Richard Kimble, a man wrongfully convicted of the murder of his wife who goes on the run from U.S. Marshals, The Fugitive , directed by Andrew Davis , shares little resemblance to other movies recognized by the Academy Awards, even the other blockbusters. And that especially applies to Jones' surprising Oscar win for playing U.S. Marshal Samuel Gerard, who leads the charge in pursuit of Kimble. When voters heard Gerard's legendary line, "I don't care," one of the coldest lines in thriller movie history, they had no choice but to hand Jones the Oscar.

title: 7 Western Movies We Actually Want to See a Remake Of
summary: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance, Tombstone, Stagecoach, and more make up our list of Western movies we actually want to see a remake of.
content: The Western is easily one of cinema’s most iconic genres, having given us some of the greatest, most influential films of all time. As the genre’s popularity has waxed and waned over the decades, many of these influential films have been remade for a new generation of audiences, sometimes successfully and other times not. However, while remakes as a trend are generally seen in a negative light, some classic Westerns really could do with a modern remake.

title: The 10 Worst Oscars Decisions of All Time, Ranked
summary: From shocking campaigns to vote splitting, some of the worst Academy Award decisions rattled cinema history.
content: Ah, the Academy Awards . Every year, cinephiles tune in for the big event as the Oscars honor the best of the best of the previous year in cinema . And like most viewers, opinions are not only present; everybody has one . While those opinions usually arrive the day nominations are officially revealed, they linger well beyond when the sealed envelope is opened, and the winner is revealed. In the almost century the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences has handed out the gold statuette, a handful of decisions have left us baffled.
